title: appkit /ui: generic auto-generated HTML console (Obsidian-embeddable nutrition view)
description:
Goal: view the nutrition app *inside* an Obsidian note (single source of truth) instead of jumping out to a browser. The nutrition HTTP server was JSON-only, so it needed an HTML view to be embeddable.

Branch: worktree-parallel-imagining-eclipse (git worktree .claude/worktrees/parallel-imagining-eclipse). Work is currently a single uncommitted edit being committed + pushed with this bead.

== DONE on this branch ==
1. packages/appkit/src/index.ts (+115 lines): added `uiHtml(app)` — a generic, dependency-free HTML console auto-generated from each operation's JSON schema. One collapsible form per operation; submitting POSTs JSON to the live `/<op>` route and renders the result (array-of-objects -> table, object -> key/value table, else pretty JSON). Niceties: auto-runs zero-arg ops on load (so `list_meals` shows immediately), formats `*_at` epoch columns as dates, click any table cell to copy its value (handy for grabbing a `meal_id`). Exposed at `GET /ui` (text/html); root `GET /` JSON now advertises `ui: "/ui"`. Because it lives in appkit it works for every app (notes/todo too). JSON API + /openapi.json unchanged; existing route contracts untouched.
2. Run it: `cd apps/nutrition && npm run serve` (= `tsx src/http.ts`) -> http://localhost:8787/ui . Default PORT 8787 (PORT env overrides). User chose MANUAL start (npm script), no launchd agent.

== ENV / BUILD NOTE ==
better-sqlite3@9.4.3 has no prebuilt binary for Node 25 and fails to native-compile there. Use Node 22 (`nvm use 22`; v22.22.0 present). Deps were (re)installed under Node 22 in this worktree for apps/nutrition and packages/appkit; node_modules are gitignored.

== VERIFICATION STATUS ==
- nutrition unit tests: 14/14 pass under Node 22 (in isolation).
- full suite once showed 55/56; the single failure was a port/timing collision when integration files run together (unit passes alone). A clean full re-run was interrupted and is still OUTSTANDING.
- `GET /ui` has NOT yet been curl-verified end-to-end, nor opened inside Obsidian.

== OBSIDIAN SETUP (the deliverable) ==
- Option A (core "Web Viewer" plugin): enable it, open http://localhost:8787/ui, drag to sidebar + bookmark.
- Option B (community "Custom Frames" plugin): add a frame with URL http://localhost:8787/ui (id `nutrition`), then embed in any note via a ```custom-frames``` code block with `frame: nutrition`. Renders via Electron webview, so localhost http loads fine.

== RELATIONSHIP TO chamber-yat (IMPORTANT — overlap) ==
chamber-yat's branch (feat/nutrition-frontend-enrichment) solves the same "view in a browser" need a DIFFERENT way: a hand-written static SPA at apps/nutrition/public/index.html served same-origin on :8080 via an opt-in `appkit serveHttp({ staticDir })`. THIS branch instead auto-generates a generic console in appkit (`/ui`, no static files, every app gets it). The two approaches OVERLAP and both modify `packages/appkit/src/index.ts` serveHttp -> expect a merge conflict. Decide: keep the generic console, the bespoke static UI, or both.

== OUTSTANDING (next) ==
A. curl-verify `GET /ui` returns HTML and that `list_meals` auto-runs; then open in Obsidian (Custom Frames / Web Viewer) to confirm rendering + localhost load.
B. Re-run full nutrition suite under Node 22 to confirm green (rule out the port-collision flake).
C. Reconcile with chamber-yat's static-UI approach (resolve the serveHttp overlap; pick one UI strategy).
D. Optional richer nutrition rendering: click a meal row to auto-fill `nutrition_for`'s meal_id (console already supports click-to-copy).
E. For Obsidian to load it, the server must be running — user opted for manual `npm run serve` rather than a launchd/login agent.

title: Finish nutrition enrichment (LLM provider) + meal-log medallion redesign
description:

Design doc: docs/nutrition-meal-log-design.md (medallion redesign + §11 loading, §4 determinism, §5 normalization, §6 recompute).

2. start.sh prints UI URL. Run via ./start.sh (Node 22 for better-sqlite3).
3. Phase-1 classification loading: seed.ts loads declarative files from apps/nutrition/data/ (nutrients.json, ingredients.json, component_mappings.json, ingredient_nutrients.csv, dataset.json) via validated, FK-ordered, idempotent loader. Behavior identical (6/8/30). 69/69 passed.

   - src/app.ts: registers enrich_meal; provider = NUTRITION_PROVIDER==llm ? llmProvider : usdaProvider (default USDA).
   - integration.test.ts: tool count 3->4, asserts enrich_meal.

== OUTSTANDING (next) ==
A. Unit test enrichMeal w/ FAKE provider (offline) in test/unit.test.ts (was mid-edit). import enrichMeal from ../src/operations.js + types from ../src/nutrition_source.js. unknown component -> enrich(fake) -> getMealNutrition shows nutrients; assert cached-skip on 2nd enrich.

C. .env.example: add USDA_FDC_API_KEY + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (start.sh exports .env to apps).
D. Web UI: per-meal Fetch-nutrition button -> POST /enrich_meal {meal_id} -> re-render; improve empty-nutrition state.
E. Full suite under Node 22 (nvm use 22; cd apps/nutrition && npm test); confirm green.
F. E2E: ./start.sh, log exotic-component meal in UI, enrich (USDA), confirm nutrition; then NUTRITION_PROVIDER=llm w/ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
